proposition: Khwāndamīr (921-35/1515-29) gave Ibn Turka only a short entry, praising his personal excellence and philanthropy and listing three works and his death date in Herat, which MK calls faint praise beside the entries for Yazdī and Kātibī.

mediation.note: late Timurid/early Safavid historian; the entry's death year is given as 83[5] with MK's bracket
